thread:
Maria: Heads up — starting a quick thread: propose a 'compat tollbooth' in the ingress to centralize minor API-version translations and rate-limit degenerate clients. Thoughts?
Ajay: Like a thin translation gate? curious about latency impact.
Maria: Yes — small per-request hop but we can keep it async/inline with hot routes. Intent: handle V1->V2 shape mapping + soft defaults so we can retire client-side shims.
Theo: Main risks: ops surface + stateful cohort assignments. Need a way to tie cohorts to auth tokens, not IP.
Lina: Another risk: tokenized cost. If tollbooth does batching or logging, costs rise. Also watch KV cache pressure.
Maria: Agreed. Proposal: tollbooth is stateless translator + header tag for cohort. Heavy transformations (e.g., parameter rework) fall back to service-side adapters.
Ajay: SLA question: do we expose an opt-out header for high-throughput tenants? Or per-tenant policy in config?
Maria: Per-tenant policy via config is my preference. Add opt-out flag `X-Compat-Bypass` allowed only for dedicated contracts. Default: ON for free/hosted.
Sam: Implementation approach: Envoy filter vs separate service? Envoy filter might be faster but harder to iterate.
Maria: Envoy for header sniff + quick rewrites. For complex JSON remaps use a sidecar translator chain (k8s). Keep routing decision in control-plane policy.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: can schedule canary if we add 'tollbooth' feature flag. Use cohort rollout wave ids.
Theo: We also need telemetry: counts per mapping rule, latency histograms, and a 'regression score' when outputs deviate vs v1 baseline.
Lina: Suggest adding sampling triggers for eval harness when mapping frequency > threshold.
Ajay: One more: cache keys. If we rewrite request shapes, cache keys must normalize shape+compat-version to avoid contamination.
Maria: Good point. I'll update RFC draft with: 1) stateless Envoy header filter, 2) sidecar JSON remapper for heavy rules, 3) per-tenant opt-out header gated by contract, 4) telemetry + eval sampling + cache normalization. Anyone object?
Theo: :thumbsup: no objections. Can we get rough latency budget? 2-3ms envoys + 5-10ms remapper?
Maria: Yes aim for <15ms p95. If we can't meet that, fallback to 'degrade to pass-through + flag tenant for manual migration'.
Lina: I'll add cost estimates. Also recommend avoiding adding new transforms to tollbooth unless bugfix.
Ajay: I'll take proto for Envoy filter and coordinate canary plan.
Maria: Thanks all. Scheduling RFC follow-up sync Thu 10am. /cc @deploy-bot
